item.title: VDEM shares fireplace safety tips ahead of winter weather
item.description: As more winter weather heads towards Central Virginia this weekend, the Virginia Department of Emergency Management (VDEM) is sharing safety tips for families turning to fireplaces to stay warm.

item.title: Many Richmond businesses close as part of nationwide general strike against recent ICE actions
item.description: After many businesses throughout Central Virginia were forced to shutter their doors or alter their hours due to impacts from the winter storm, many have decided to close again on Friday, but for a different reason -- as part of the nationwide general strike.

item.title: Richmond breast surgeon sued for medical negligence, allegedly leaving patient disfigured
item.description: A Richmond breast surgeon, along with two local medical facilities, is being sued for medical negligence and allegedly performing surgical procedures she was not qualified for.

item.title: All lanes closed near Dinwiddie County Airport due to crash
item.description: All lanes are closed near Dinwiddie County Airport due to a crash late Friday night.

item.title: Richmond under State of Emergency ahead of winter weather, Avula says
item.description: Richmond Mayor Danny Avula has announced that the city is under a state of emergency due to continued icy conditions and the impact of winter weather expected to move through this weekend.

item.title: 'It just takes being willing': Local church stays open through storm to help those in need
item.description: They planned for 48 hours, now they're 6 days in -- Awaken Church RVA has stayed open throughout the recent storm, providing a warm place to stay and other resources to vulnerable community members.

item.title: Attorney General Jay Jones joins multistate lawsuit challenging SNAP restrictions
item.description: Attorney General Jay Jones (D) on Friday joined a coalition of 23 other attorneys general to challenge the Trump administration's effort to illegally restrict eligibility for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP).

item.title: Richmond area businesses feel split impact of lingering winter weather
item.description: Days after a winter storm swept through Central Virginia, lingering ice continues to coat streets, creating a setback for some Richmond area businesses while sending demand soaring for others.

item.title: Staying open, standing together: How local businesses are supporting the nationwide shutdown
item.description: In response to deadly immigration enforcement-related incidents in Minneapolis, dozens of Richmond businesses are taking a stand - without closing their doors.
